name: Xing 4.0 29B A4B
short: China Telecom TeleAI's Sep 2026 Apache-2.0 MoE (29B/4B active, 256K, 512K via YaRN): SWE-bench Verified 75.0%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 57.5% - first model of its scale trained on Ascend NPUs.
pricingNote: Apache 2.0 open weights (self-host free); OpenRouter free route xingchen-agi/xing4.0-29b-a4b:free
freeTierNote: Free promotional OpenCode Zen tier; Apache 2.0 weights self-host free
standout: A 29B agentic model with 75% SWE-bench Verified, trained end-to-end on Ascend NPUs with MindSpore.
tradeoff: Every number is vendor-published, no GPQA or LiveCodeBench figure exists, and the Ascend-first stack is a portability caveat outside China.
